_comment: Citizens we never audit, grouped by the operator who runs them ('big boys').
These are curated by the user, not derived: an operator with deep reserves and a
standing builder relationship cures at the top of the boundary block whatever the
on-chain history suggests, so spending a scarce auditor slot on one is wasted.
This is the authority — rival-targets.json, rival-skippers.json and the target
analysis all exclude these, and scripts/rival-skippers.mjs reads it instead of
keeping its own exclusion list. Allies live separately in ally-tokens.json.
